@liuzhen9320 logs 10 commits in a week, peaking with 4 on Monday
NOT A DRILL

EXPERTS BAFFLED
@liuzhen9320 reviews no PRs, yet still manages 10 commits without a merge
DEVELOPING
@liuzhen9320 spikes commit count on Monday, then maintains steady daily pushes
UNPRECEDENTED
@liuzhen9320 ends the week with a final two‑commit push, keeping the streak alive
